name: Order Template Starters
summary: Built-in schedule, policy, Loop, and Workflow order templates for durable workspace mandates.

seeds.title: Daily Operating Brief
seeds.summary: Prepare a short daily operating brief with blockers, active work, and required approvals.
seeds.content:
---
type: schedule
owner: operations
cadence: weekday-morning
---
# Daily Operating Brief

## Goal
Produce a concise daily brief for the selected Space.

## Include
- Active Orders and Work runs
- Blockers requiring human input
- Evidence links for completed work
- Next actions with owners

## Exit
The brief is ready for human review.

seeds.title: Weekly Policy Review
seeds.summary: Review active policies, suspended orders, and stale automation assumptions once per week.
seeds.content:
---
type: policy
owner: operations
cadence: weekly
---
# Weekly Policy Review

## Goal
Keep active Space policies accurate and auditable.

## Review
- Active and suspended Orders
- Required secrets and provider refs
- Loops that failed to exit cleanly
- Workflow templates that need updated evidence gates

## Exit
Policy changes are drafted or explicitly deferred with owner and date.

seeds.title: Deploy Verification Mandate
seeds.summary: Run deploy verification until smoke checks pass and release evidence is attached.
seeds.content:
---
type: loop
loop_template: deploy-verification
owner: delivery
---
# Deploy Verification Mandate

## Goal
Use the Deploy Verification Loop for every release that changes runtime behavior.

## Required Evidence
- Build or release identifier
- Smoke command output
- Route or API proof
- Rollback decision if checks fail

## Exit
All smoke checks pass or rollback is completed and documented.
